features.name: project scaffolding
features.description: Minimal repo layout with package manager, formatter/linter, and empty src modules so TDD can start. Covers pyproject (uv, python>=3.12, torch, transformers, datasets), black+ruff config, src/ stubs, kaggle/ and results/ dirs.

tests.notes: import check: every src module imports cleanly on CPU

features.name: variant A backbone and attention
features.description: Real-valued LLaMA-style block (RMSNorm, SwiGLU h=1408, RoPE base 10000, non-causal doc-blocked) with Apple sigmoid attention (alpha=sigmoid(QK^T/sqrt(d)+b), b init -log N). Width d=512, 8 layers/8 heads, tied 50258x512 embedding.

tests.notes: param count ~51.4M; init RMS ~1; RoPE identity; 20-step overfit finite

features.name: variant B complex PCT attention
features.description: Complex-valued twin of F002: complex QKV/Wo and FFN (h=320 complex), complex RMSNorm with complex gain, PCT gate (unit-norm q/k, s=Re<qbar,kbar>*sqrt(d), alpha=sigmoid(s+b)), RoPE on interleaved (Re,Im) view, [Re;Im] concat (736 real) to tied 50258x736 embedding. dc=368, 8/8 heads (headdim 46 complex).

tests.notes: total ~51.3M (<0.5% vs A); init RMS ~1; RoPE rotation identity; complex matmul via (...,2) Re/Im form

features.notes: Init: Re/Im ~N(0,1/sqrt(2*fan_in)), gain 1+0i, eps 1e-6, embed N(0,0.02).

features.name: masked diffusion loss and sampler
features.description: MDLM compute_loss port: absorbing-state forward, t=(1-eps)*u+eps eps=1e-3, 1/t weight in fp32, antithetic pairing per 16-row micro-batch, mask prob 1-t, EOS never masked, SUBS (-inf on MASK logit), CE on masked only. Plus LLaDA-style 32-step confidence unmask/remask sampler.

tests.notes: loss finite; SUBS kills mask short-circuit; sampler fills answer slots deterministically at temp 0

features.notes: MDLM code is ground truth where spec is ambiguous.

features.name: ultrachat data pipeline
features.description: Download HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k, subsample 40k train_sft + 2k test_sft (seed 42), format turns as plain text, GPT-2 BPE + MASK token (vocab 50258), chunk to <=512, greedy-pack to 512 rows with EOS joins, doc-block masks, doc-relative RoPE positions, identical order/seeds for A/B.

tests.notes: packing shapes, EOS never masked, doc masks block cross-doc attention

features.name: training loop
features.description: Identical-hypers A/B loop: ~2300 steps x batch 128 (16x8 accum) x 512 (~150M tokens), AdamW (0.9,0.95) wd 1e-5, clip 1.0, LR in {3e-4,1e-3} via preflight probe, cosine to LR/10 + 230-step warmup, fp16 AMP (fp32 loss) with bf16 flag, torch.compile, no grad checkpointing (micro-16 fits natively), ckpt every 500 + resume, gate-sum histogram logging.

features.name: copy and NIAH probes
features.description: Deterministic generators (~200/cell, windows 512+1024): 2 solved demos + 1 test joined by EOT; Copy K in {8,16,32} over A-P ids 32-47 with ~ filler id 93; NIAH distractor ids 0-63 excl 30 plus 64, cue ? id 30, depths {0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9}; 32-step argmax decode on answer slots; Wilson CI + void (<=2x chance) + discrimination scoring.

tests.notes: generator token-id pins + decode/score path covered in smoke test

features.name: fixed-prompt generation
features.description: Sample first 20 validation conversations for both checkpoints: 32 denoising steps, 128 tokens, identical LLaDA-style confidence remasking and settings, EOS/doc rules mirrored from training.

tests.notes: sampler smoke: fixed seed produces finite shaped output

features.name: smoke test suite
features.description: CPU suite: A/B param counts <0.5%, init RMS ~1 both variants, RoPE rotation identity, loss finite + 20-step overfit, probe generators + decode/score path, sampler runs.

tests.notes: written first per TDD; gates every other feature

features.name: kaggle parallel venue
features.description: Kernel metadata + push script: A/B train in parallel one per T4, 50-step throughput probe then 500-step x 2-LR probe, ~4600-step full run, joint eval, ckpt every 500 for session-death resume.

tests.notes: dry-run push script without GPU spend

features.name: results report
features.description: results.md comparing A vs B across ELBO, probes (Wilson CIs, void/noise calls), and 20 eyeballed samples; includes param counts, wall-clock, single-seed limitation, named confounds, and sensitivity-rerun outcome if triggered (B h=832 complex).
